title: Collection Feedback (composed)
description: Generated by 08-tools/build-schemas.ts from the raw schema plus registered extensions. Do not edit by hand. Regenerate with: node 08-tools/build-schemas.ts
x-docIdRule: The document id is {date}_{wardId}_{a short device suffix}, as the user app writes it today.
x-singleApp: Only the user app touches this collection. It is NOT a shared collection. No other app may read it.
x-reads: userapp: own only, scoped by the deviceId claim

wardId.description: The ward the feedback is about.

deviceId.description: The citizen's install id. The read rule compares it against the deviceId claim.

hadGarbage.description: Was there garbage at the collection point on that day.

collectionStatus.description: What the citizen saw. missed_by_van is a complaint about a missed collection and it feeds the missedCollectionAlert server function.

id.description: A copy of the Firestore document id. The user app's feedback object is a round-trip shape, so the id has to survive a write and a read.

reason.description: The citizen's free text about the missed collection. Optional.

timestamp.description: When the citizen gave the feedback.

syncStatus.description: The user app's own sync bookkeeping. It is a hint for the app's UI, not a fact about the collection.
